definitionEn: to throw away or get rid of something you no longer want or need
situation: You throw out an object, a draft or an idea because it is no longer useful to you.

examples.text: Before moving house, we [[discarded]] boxes of old magazines that nobody had opened in years.
The researchers [[discarded]] their first theory when new data failed to support it.
Staff must [[discard]] any food that has passed its use-by date.

texts: Halve the peppers and [[discard]] the seeds.
Good editors know when to [[discard]] a weak paragraph.
Never [[discard]] receipts until you have checked your bank statement.

badCollocation.noteRu: От приглашения или предложения отказываются — decline или turn down. Discard — выбросить ненужное или отбросить идею.

collocationTask.prompt: Peel the potatoes and ___ the skins.
collocationTask.explanationRu: Кожуру, упаковку и мусор выбрасывают — discard. Reject и dismiss — отклонить предложение или идею, abandon — бросить машину, дом или проект.

nuance.text: Once you have checked the contents, you can [[discard]] the plastic wrapping.
nuance.explanationRu: Discard — выбросить то, что у вас уже есть и больше не нужно. Reject — не принять то, что вам предлагают; к упаковке это не подходит.

reverse.text: She [[rejected]] the job offer because the salary was too low.
reverse.explanationRu: От предложения работы отказываются — reject или turn down. Discard — выбросить за ненадобностью, а не отклонить.

fixIt.text: Once the contracts had been scanned, we [[deleted]] all the paper copies.
fixIt.explanationRu: Delete — удалить файл или текст в компьютере. Бумажные копии выбрасывают — discard.

reply.context: A colleague messages: "We've got three pages of ideas from the brainstorm. Do we keep them all?"
options: Let's discard the meeting and brainstorm again next week.
Let's discard the weakest ones and focus on the two or three that could really work.
It is advisable that the aforementioned ideas be discarded forthwith.
reply.explanationRu: Идеи можно discard — отбросить как ненужные. Встречу не discard, а cancel или postpone. Третий вариант звучит как юридический документ, а не ответ коллеге.

rewrite.original: We threw away the old sofa because it was falling apart.
rewrite.frame: The old sofa ____ because it was falling apart.
rewrite.explanationRu: Нужен пассив: the sofa was discarded.

definitionEn: to officially allow a patient to leave hospital or a soldier to leave the army
senseNote: Здесь — выписать пациента или уволить со службы; значения «сбрасывать (отходы)» и «исполнять (обязанности)» не рассматриваются.
situation: Doctors decide a patient is well enough to go home, or the army lets a soldier leave.

examples.text: She was [[discharged]] from hospital two days after the operation and is now recovering at home.
After injuring his back in training, he was [[discharged]] from the navy and went back to university.
The ward is full because patients cannot be [[discharged]] until someone can care for them at home.

texts: Grandad was [[discharged]] on Friday and is already bored at home.
She was [[discharged]] from the army after twelve years of service.
Most patients are [[discharged]] within a week of surgery.

badCollocation.noteRu: Из гостиницы «выписываются» сами — check out. Discharge — выписка из больницы или увольнение с военной службы.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Пациента выписывают — discharge. Fire — уволить работника, expel — исключить из школы, resign — уйти с должности самому.

nuance.text: The hospital will [[discharge]] him as soon as his temperature is back to normal.
nuance.explanationRu: Discharge — официально отпустить пациента домой. Dismiss — уволить работника или отвергнуть идею; пациента так не «выписывают».

reverse.text: The company [[dismissed]] two managers after the audit.
reverse.explanationRu: Уволить сотрудника компании — dismiss. Discharge в этом значении используют для больницы и военной службы.

fixIt.text: The doctor said she would [[write out]] my father on Friday if his tests were normal.
fixIt.explanationRu: Write out — выписать рецепт или чек. Пациента из больницы «выписывают» — discharge.

reply.context: A friend texts: "Any news about your grandmother? Is she still in hospital?"
options: Yes, she discharged the doctors this morning and went home.
Affirmative. The patient's discharge has been duly processed.
Good news, they discharged her this morning, so she's back home now.
reply.explanationRu: Выписывают пациента (discharged her), а не врачей. Второй вариант звучит как больничный отчёт, а не сообщение другу.

definitionEn: to make information known, especially something that was secret or private
situation: A company, official or person reveals information that was private or secret until then.

examples.text: The company refused to [[disclose]] the price it had paid for the land.
You are not legally required to [[disclose]] a medical condition to your employer.
Police have not [[disclosed]] the identity of the man who was arrested.

texts: Doctors cannot [[disclose]] your records without your consent.
The buyer asked us not to [[disclose]] the price.
You must [[disclose]] any previous convictions on the form.

badCollocation.noteRu: «Раскрыть дело» — solve a case. Disclose — сделать известной скрытую информацию, а не найти преступника.

collocationTask.prompt: refuse to ___ the identity of the buyer
collocationTask.explanationRu: Disclose — сообщить то, что знаешь сам. Discover и uncover — узнать или обнаружить скрытое, disclaim — отказаться от ответственности.

nuance.text: The bank must [[disclose]] all its fees before you sign the contract.
nuance.explanationRu: Disclose — сообщить другим то, что знаешь. Discover — самому узнать что-то новое; банк не «обнаруживает» свои комиссии, а раскрывает их клиенту.

reverse.text: Scientists have [[discovered]] a new species of frog in the rainforest.
reverse.explanationRu: Найти что-то новое — discover. Disclose — раскрыть сведения, которые у вас уже есть.

fixIt.text: Neither company is allowed to [[open]] the details of the deal to journalists.
fixIt.explanationRu: «Раскрыть» сведения — не open, а disclose (или reveal). Open — открыть дверь, файл или счёт.

reply.context: A friend asks: "So how much did they offer you? Come on, tell me!"
options: Sorry, I promised not to disclose the figure until I've signed the contract.
Let me disclose the envelope first, then I'll tell you.
Pursuant to the confidentiality clause, I am unable to disclose said figure.
reply.explanationRu: Disclose — сообщить скрытую информацию (сумму, условия). Конверт не disclose, а open. Третий вариант звучит как юридический документ, а не ответ другу.

rewrite.original: The hospital did not reveal the patient's name.
rewrite.frame: The patient's name ____ by the hospital.
rewrite.explanationRu: Нужен пассив: the name was not disclosed.

definitionEn: the act of making secret or private information known to others
situation: Information that was kept secret or private is officially made public or shared with others.

examples.text: New rules require full [[disclosure]] of executives' pay in the annual report.
Data protection law restricts the [[disclosure]] of customers' personal details to third parties.
Her memoir includes the painful [[disclosure]] that she had struggled with gambling for years.

texts: The [[disclosure]] of the minister's private emails caused a scandal.
Full [[disclosure]]: I used to work for the company I'm reviewing.
Any [[disclosure]] of patient records requires written consent.

badCollocation.noteRu: «Раскрыть потенциал» — realise или fulfil your potential. Disclosure — только обнародование скрытых сведений.

collocationTask.prompt: full ___ of all fees and charges
collocationTask.explanationRu: Обязательное раскрытие информации — full disclosure. Exposure — разоблачение чего-то плохого, opening — открытие, appearance — появление.

nuance.text: Companies must make a formal [[disclosure]] of any risks to their investors.
nuance.explanationRu: Disclosure — официальное раскрытие сведений по закону или правилам. Revelation — неожиданное, сенсационное открытие; для отчёта инвесторам не подходит.

reverse.text: Her talent for comedy was a [[revelation]] to the audience.
reverse.explanationRu: Неожиданное приятное открытие — a revelation. Disclosure — официальное раскрытие информации, к таланту не подходит.

fixIt.text: Shareholders demanded the [[opening]] of the directors' salaries.
fixIt.explanationRu: «Раскрытие» сведений — disclosure. Opening — открытие магазина, выставки или счёта.

wordFormation.text: The [[disclosure]] of the documents led to a public inquiry.

definitionEn: the way a subject is discussed in public, in speech and writing
situation: You describe how politicians, the media and ordinary people talk and write about an issue.

examples.text: Many people feel that political [[discourse]] has become angrier since the rise of social media.
The course examines how gender is represented in academic and media [[discourse]].
Experts are calling for a calmer, better-informed public [[discourse]] on artificial intelligence.

texts: Online [[discourse]] often rewards outrage more than careful thought.
The scandal dominated political [[discourse]] for weeks.
Her book changed the [[discourse]] around mental health.

badCollocation.text: a [[discourse]] with a friend about films
badCollocation.noteRu: Дружеская беседа — conversation или chat. Discourse — книжное слово о том, как тема обсуждается в обществе или науке.

collocationTask.explanationRu: С discourse говорят engage in — «участвовать в обсуждении». Make, perform и conduct с этим существительным не сочетаются.

nuance.text: The study looks at how climate change is framed in political [[discourse]].
nuance.explanationRu: Discourse — вся совокупность того, как о теме говорят и пишут в обществе. Discussion — конкретное обсуждение между людьми; framed in political discussion звучит неестественно.

reverse.text: We had a long [[discussion]] about where to go on holiday.
reverse.explanationRu: Разговор нескольких людей о конкретном деле — discussion. Discourse — книжное слово для публичного обсуждения, а не беседы о поездке.

fixIt.text: Her thesis analyses how older people are portrayed in advertising and newspaper [[speech]].
fixIt.explanationRu: «Газетная речь» — не newspaper speech, а newspaper discourse (или language). Speech — устная речь или выступление.
